beats.text: At last Hanuman landed on Mount Lamba in Lanka, a city of gold with towering walls, built on a mountain peak in the middle of the sea.
Its walls were gold, its gates were guarded by thousands of demons with spears and bows, and its moats were full of crocodiles.
So he waited for night. Then he shrank to the size of a cat and crept toward the gate in the moonlight.
Lankini, the guardian spirit of the city, stopped him. She was huge and terrible, with blazing eyes. 'No one enters Lanka,' she roared, 'without my permission.'
Hanuman did not want to hurt her badly. He tapped her lightly, just once, with his left hand.
She fell, and remembered Brahma's old prophecy: 'When a monkey defeats you, Lanka's end is near.'
'Go in, mighty one,' she said, 'and find the daughter of Janaka.'
